title: Chip Mc
content: At age fifteen, while lying on a hospital bed in the emergency room after I overdosed on methamphetamine, my heart stopped. The last thing I saw was my own flatline on the monitor. Immediately, I saw myself from a third-person viewpoint. I sat up in the bed, raised my hands up to the light on the ceiling. The light then expanded all around me and I began floating upward. I then turned around and looked down at my physical body. As I passed through the roof of the hospital, the light went away. I was hundreds of feet above the hospital. It was a dark evening, and I could see my city below. A being appeared next to me that had a basic human shape but with no distinct features like eyes, ears, a nose, or a mouth. It appeared to be made of water and was almost invisible, like in the movie "Predator" when the creature activates its cloak. We flew side by side over the south end of my town. I turned and looked over at the Being and it "looked" at me and then reassured me that I would be okay. But it didn't actually speak. I just knew what it was communicating to me. The Being had no gender, but it did feel more feminine and softer. There was no noise during the experience, just silence and serenity. I never thought about the traumatic overdose I had just gone through. It was like I had no past. I was only in the now. Suddenly, like a strong magnet, I was pulled back into my body. The serenity was gone. The doctors were all around me and my mom was crying. I was panicking, asking the doctors what had just happened to me. For decades I've wondered what it all meant. It did not make me religious, but it has made me more aware of the separation between my consciousness and this physical body I'm currently occupying. I'm forty-six now. I'm not afraid to die. I don't want to die anytime soon, but I am also looking forward to it.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Drug or medication overdose, Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.At what time during the experience were: Immediately as I left my body, before the light surrounded me.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, I had no thought about time.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I didn't hear anything with my ears
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain, The light over my hospital bed did expand around me as I floated through the ceiling. I've never considered that a tunnel.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, As I passed through the ceiling, the light was all around me.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Uncertain, I was young, so I do not know if I am different than I was going to be.
elements.What is your religion now?: Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I've always believed that there is something more after death. I was only 15 so I hadn't thought about it much and my family is not religious.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I know now that "heaven" is for everyone. Consciousness cannot die.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, A Being with a human shape that seemed to be made of water.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain, I've experienced ESP. I don't know if I had this ability before.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: When the Being looked at me and spoke to me using telepathy. That was unforgettable.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, I watched shows like Unsolved Mysteries as a kid so I've seen the reenactments of NDEs. But, mine was unlike anything I've seen on TV.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, I know it happened. I was there.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, It happened.
